effects.does: Clicking it opens the Clara assistant.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data changes.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the assistant drawer opens without changing the drafts list.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the event-creation screen.
effects.affects: Nothing is added to the event records until the buyer completes and saves or publishes the event.
effects.check: Click Create Event M and verify that the event-creation screen is displayed.

effects.does: Clicking it switches the list to live events.
effects.affects: The visible event list changes from drafts to live events.
effects.check: Click Live 8583 and verify that live events are shown and the Live tab is selected.

effects.does: Clicking it switches the list to historical events.
effects.affects: The visible event list changes from drafts to historical events.
effects.check: Click History 2035 and verify that historical events are shown and the History tab is selected.

effects.does: It keeps the buyer on the drafts view.
effects.affects: The visible event list is filtered to draft events and no event data is modified.
effects.check: Verify that Drafts 183 is selected and only draft events are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking it switches the list to recurring events.
effects.affects: The visible event list changes from drafts to recurring events.
effects.check: Click Recurring and verify that recurring events are shown and the Recurring tab is selected.

effects.does: Entering text filters the displayed events by title.
effects.affects: Only matching event records remain visible in the current drafts list; event data is not changed.
effects.check: Enter a known draft title and verify that matching titles remain while nonmatching titles are hidden.
